Then, you can use the quadratic formula, which is x = [-b ± √(b² - 4ac)] / (2a). This formula will give you the values of x that satisfy the equation. To find the stationary points of an equation y = f(x), you first need to find the derivative of the function, which is dy/dx. Then, you set the derivative equal to zero and solve for x.
